pythonFunction.name: enrol_budget_plan
pythonFunction.description:
Enrolls the customer in a Budget Plan with a fixed monthly amount. Needs an authenticated caller
and the customer's clear agreement to the amount. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the authenticated account (REQUIRED).
    monthly_amount: Monthly installment in dollars the customer agreed to (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, confirmation_number and monthly_amount.
